about: Usability acceptance set: questions a real user asks about the five Gutenberg books in the Shared library. Each item states the behaviour the user should get. expect: answer | library | not_in_sources | smalltalk. cite: at least one citation must come from a document whose name contains one of these. mention: the answer must contain at least one of these (case-insensitive). Multi-turn items send turns in order in one chat; checks apply to the last turn. Multilingual items (added 2026-09-29) ask in the book's own language; cross-language items ask in English about a non-English book. mention lists include the term in both languages where the answer may come back in either. ambiguity items: expect 'answer' with `mention_all` listing BOTH referents — the corpus answers the question two ways (KI-27's Wukong shape). They are expected to fail today and are marked pending_p2, so the scorer reports them separately and they do not count against today's pass rate. forbid: a real-world value the document deliberately contradicts; mentioning it fails the item.
